context: User reported only Kakao login fails. Could not test against real Kakao credentials in this sandbox, so this round fixes the one concrete bug found and lists actionable config checks.
real_bug_found: kakao-callback.js's catch block and failure checks replaced every real error with a generic message, discarding Kakao's own error_description/error/msg fields entirely, making it impossible to tell why it failed.
fix: Now surfaces the actual reason at every failure point: OAuth error/error_description if denied, the token endpoint's error_description if code exchange fails, the profile endpoint's msg if user-info fails, and the real exception message otherwise.
likely_causes_to_check: Using the wrong key type as KAKAO_CLIENT_ID (must be the REST API key specifically, not native app/JS/admin key -- a very common first-time mistake). Redirect URI must match exactly what's registered. If Client Secret is activated on Kakao's side, KAKAO_CLIENT_SECRET must also be set in Cloudflare env vars.
next_step: Please retry Kakao login and share the new, more specific error message so the exact remaining cause can be pinpointed.

verification.regression_suite: Graph integrity, stuck-node escape, and speed equalization all pass unchanged (only kakao-callback.js was touched).
